title: FBI Photo B13
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report to AARO regarding a single still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect.

incidents.summary: A grainy grayscale surveillance image showing two small, dark, elongated objects near the center of the frame.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: An elongated, dark (hot) object is visible just below and to the right of the crosshair's center point.
